name: Halloween Night at Magic Moments Restaurant
venue: Magic Moments Restaurante & Dance Club Porto
description: A Halloween dinner with live sensual shows, costumed characters and music at Magic Moments Restaurant & Dance Club on 31 October, 20:00 to 01:00. Adults only. Tickets from €50.
longDescription:
Magic Moments Restaurant & Dance Club is holding its second Halloween night. The evening combines a full dinner with live shows built around a Halloween theme.

The night includes sensual performances, costumed characters, music and audience interaction. The organisers suggest it for couples, groups of friends and hen parties. You can choose between several menus, including Premium, VIP and Singular.

The event is at Magic Moments Restaurant & Dance Club Porto on Saturday 31 October 2026, from 20:00 to 01:00. It's for over-18s only. After buying a ticket, you must call 916 816 519 to confirm your reservation. Tickets from €50.
